notes: GenApp's VSAM 'add customer' (LGACVS01, LINKed by LGACDB01 with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA): EXEC CICS WRITE FILE('KSDSCUST') FROM(CA-CUSTOMER-NUM) LENGTH(225) RIDFLD(CA-CUSTOMER-NUM) KEYLENGTH(10); on NORMAL the program GOBACKs (no RETURN command, CA-RETURN-CODE untouched). Each scenario's KSDSCUST is compared after the task. Every non-NORMAL RESP in this program goes to WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, whose first act is EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('LGSTSQ') (GenApp's TS/TD error logger). The harness runs one program, but the case's programs list adds LGSTSQ to the same task (X6, #4607), so the error paths run: DUPREC on an existing key, NOSPACE and IOERR on the WRITE (CA-RETURN-CODE '80', ABEND LGV0). A task that reaches WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE runs to its end: LGSTSQ's WRITEQ TD / TS of a LENGTH past its 95-byte WRITE-MSG (104 bytes from the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG) is padded with spaces on both sides and ASSUMED (register X6, `x6_padded`, #5252), so the RESP, the file, both logged messages and the end state are compared; the proof names X6 among its assumptions. The faults list injects the file RESPs a healthy data set cannot give (IOERR, NOSPACE); the region ASSIGN SYSID is a deployment fact the corpus does not name. A call with no COMMAREA is not covered: the program reads LINKAGE past EIBCALEN 0 (X23-class), which the two sides do not agree on. NOTOPEN is not injected. Keys: CA-CUSTOMER-NUM is PIC 9(10) in the COMMAREA, so a key mixing letters and digits cannot be passed; no browse, so no key order is exercised (the comparison sorts each side's records by key bytes). Data: ksdscust.txt is GenApp's own ten sample customers (base/cntl/db2cre.jcl's customer INSERTs), laid out as LGACVS01 writes them (CA-CUSTOMER-NUM + CA-CUSTOMER-REQUEST's first 215 bytes); CA-NUM-POLICIES is the count of that customer's rows in db2cre.jcl's policy INSERTs.
